faq.title: The database is empty after a restart
lines: The -v flag on docker compose down deletes the database volume. Plain docker compose down and docker compose stop keep your data.
After a wipe, run make migrate to rebuild the tables.

faq.title: Login is blocked after failed attempts
lines: Several wrong passwords or wrong authentication codes in a row slow sign-in for that account and for your network.
The sign-in answer says how many seconds to wait. Wait that long and try again with the right details.

faq.title: The dashboard shows a blank screen
lines: Check that frontend/.env.local holds NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL pointing at your backend, for example http://localhost:8000.
Restart the dashboard after you change it.

faq.title: The contact form does not send emails
lines: The API needs RESEND_API_KEY and FROM_EMAIL set and the sending domain verified.
Outside development it answers 503 until both are right.

faq.title: Login says too many requests
lines: The login endpoint allows 5 requests a minute for each address. Wait a minute and try again.
Behind a shared network address the limit is shared with everyone on it.

Open a new issue on GitHub and pick the form that fits: a bug, a feature, a hardware problem or a docs problem.
1. Search the open issues in case we already know about it.
2. Say what you did, what you expected and what happened instead.
3. Add the version you run and the exact error as text.
4. Leave out passwords and keys.
A security problem never goes in an issue. Type /security instead.
Please report a security problem privately. Never in this server and never by direct message.
We remove posts that describe a vulnerability and we never ask for detail in public.

mod_guide.title: A raid
steps: Time out the accounts that are posting. Do not argue with them.
Tell the owner in moderator-only. If the owner is away, a Maintainer starts banning.
The owner pauses invites and direct messages.
Delete what was posted. Leave the entries in mod-log.
When it is quiet, the owner raises the verification level for a day and writes two lines in moderator-only on what happened.

mod_guide.title: A member report
steps: Read the link first. The link is the evidence. The words under Why are the reporter's own and are not verified.
Open a thread on the entry in mod-log.
Say in the thread what you did.
React with a tick when it is done.
A report about a member of staff arrives by email, so tell the owner.

mod_guide.title: A security post
steps: Delete the message if it gives detail.
Post /mod reply with the security template.
Never ask for detail in public or in a direct message.

mod_guide.title: A timeout
steps: Remind first. A timeout is for repeat or serious breaks of the rules.
Use the shortest timeout that stops the harm.
Write what you did and why in moderator-only.
A Moderator cannot act on a Maintainer. Pass it on.

mod_reply.text: Please do not share the details of a security problem here or in a direct message. Report it privately instead: type /security to see how. We never take reports by direct message.
Please search this forum and the documentation first. The /docs and /faq commands can help. If you cannot find an answer, post again and say what you tried.
We need more detail to help. Please add what you were trying to do, the version you run, how you run it and the exact error as text in a code block.
Please keep one question in each post. Open a new post for the next question so that each answer is easy to find.
Please keep the tone kind and patient. Our Code of Conduct applies everywhere in this server.
Please write in English in the public channels so that everyone can follow, moderators included.
Please ask in public and not by direct message. The answer then helps the next person. We never ask for a password, a key or money in a direct message.
